The first 9 chapters of my webcomic Zoe the Vampire. If you like it please check out my site, I update with a new page every week and there is many more pages that aren't included here. I am in a slow process of redrawing all of these pages after getting a prequel chapter done, will take likely 2 years to redraw all this, just like this took 2 years to draw.
